 Puka Nacua , WR (LAR) 
 Returns after brief exit
 Home   >  News 
 Nov 8 8:13pm 
 Nacua returned to Sunday's game against the Commanders after visiting the medical tent, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.
 Nacua was evaluated after sustaining an unspecified injury, but his absence wound up being brief. Barring another issue, he appears to be good to go for the remainder of Sunday's contest.
